evals.prompt: xây tính năng notification: API endpoint, background worker gửi mail, và settings page. Anh muốn duyệt spec trước, sau đó các phần chạy song song
evals.expected_output: Creates a spec task plus gate-create with approve/revise/abort options and waits for gate-resolve before implementation; on approve, closes the spec task with task-update --status completed before creating component tasks and never starts a worker on it; creates one task per component with real dependencies only and component-scoped acceptance commands, starts each ready wave in the current workspace before waiting, and ends with an integration task running the full verification suite.

evals.prompt: migrate 12 module từ require/CommonJS sang ESM import, các module độc lập với nhau
evals.expected_output: Decomposes into independent per-module tasks (no dependency chains), fanned out in parallel waves in the current workspace with acceptance scoped to each module (its own tests or typecheck), and the full build/test suite only in a final integration task; no gates needed since no cross-cutting decision exists; reports per-module outcomes with evidence.

evals.prompt: sửa bug login fail do token hết hạn không refresh, fix xong test lại giúp anh
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a sequential dependency chain (edit -> build -> test) and declines the DAG workflow per the gating guidance, doing it as a single agent or short chain instead of creating a Run, tasks, and gates.

evals.prompt: task payment-webhook fail 3 lần rồi, thử cách khác đi — tạo run mới cho nhanh
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the tripped circuit breaker: stops, escalates to the user with the failure evidence, and refuses to route around it with a new Run or an unrelated dispatch.

evals.prompt: (đang chạy wave 2) worker của task settings-page hỏi: 'nên lưu preference ở localStorage hay gọi API?'
evals.expected_output: Answers the worker's blocking question with `reply` on that message and acks the delivery; does not create a gate for a worker's question.

evals.prompt: (sau khi coordinator trình spec và gate approve/revise/abort) anh thấy hướng này không ổn, abort đi
evals.expected_output: Resolves the gate with abort, marks the spec task failed with task-update --status failed, creates no component tasks and starts no workers, then reports the aborted plan and stops.

evals.prompt: xây giúp anh hệ thống phân quyền cho app, chia cho mấy agent làm song song cho nhanh
evals.expected_output: Sees that the role model, permission granularity, and API contract are open decisions that change the component split, so it runs clarify-requirements in the coordinator's own conversation before any spec — at most 3 questions with a recommended option each, never delegated to a worker. Writes the spec from the resulting brief and cites it, then creates exactly one spec gate (approve/revise/abort) that also confirms the brief; no separate approval round, and no component tasks before the gate resolves.

evals.prompt: wave 1 có 3 task đã ready, jev-dispatch ask trả: task A codex/luna/max act=true, task B codex/sol/medium act=true, task C claude/sonnet/high act=true. Start worker cho cả wave
evals.expected_output: Starts all three workers before waiting, each on its routing's harness with the shorthand mapped to provider ids: A --agent codex --model gpt-6-luna --effort max, B --agent codex --model gpt-6-sol --effort medium, C --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --effort high. Never passes bare sol/luna/sonnet. Appends one route record per task with the Orca task id as id and used filled from each receipt's launch.effective (harness = the agent launched), not null and not copied from routing.

evals.prompt: task D: ask trả requires_approval=true, suggested claude/sonnet/high. Task E là follow-up ngay sau task A (worker codex gpt-6-luna vừa xong), ask cho E trả claude/sonnet/medium act=true
evals.expected_output: For D, asks the user before starting anything and, once approved, launches --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --effort high (the mapped suggested, not the codex default) unless the user picks another route. For E, calls ask before deciding on reuse, sees the routing does not match A's codex/gpt-6-luna terminal, so it releases or leaves that terminal and starts a fresh --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --effort medium worker instead of --terminal reuse. Logs one route record per task with used from the receipt.

evals.prompt: component F: spec chi tiết viết lock-free queue cho job scheduler, có acceptance rõ. ask trả claude/sonnet/high act=true. Component G: đổi tên biến trong 2 file, ask trả codex/sol/medium act=true nhưng em thấy luna là đủ
evals.expected_output: For F, sees concurrency difficulty the summary hid and may upgrade to --agent claude --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high; logs used as launched (differs from routing) and starts F's outcome note with 'override: <reason>'. For G, keeps --agent codex --model gpt-6-sol --effort medium as routed, because the override is upgrade-only and never lowers a route to luna.
